personal.title: Make every mile count.
personal.description: Pedal to the Polls is more than miles on a bike. It’s about building momentum for permanently protecting the Boundary Waters in communities across Minnesota.
additionalParagraphs: Your gift today will help power this statewide effort to elect Boundary Waters Champions who will fight to permanently protect the Boundary Waters watershed from toxic copper mining.
Help fuel Pedal to the Polls. Help elect Boundary Waters Champions.

business.title: Join us for the ride. Sponsor Pedal to the Polls.
business.description: Help make Pedal to the Polls possible by becoming a sponsor. Your support will bring the message of permanently protecting the Boundary Waters to communities across Minnesota while putting your business alongside a growing community of businesses that care about Canoe Country.
additionalParagraphs: Pedal to the Polls sponsors will be recognized throughout the ride, including opportunities for logo placement on the Pedal to the Polls canoe, recognition on the website, emails, and signage, and the opportunity to connect with participants at community events.
